intro.title: A Congolese group dedicated to entrepreneurship
paragraphs: TADI LEWA GROUP SARLU is a company based in Kinshasa, in the Ngaliema district. We support project leaders, young entrepreneurs and growing businesses by providing advice, training, visibility and partnership opportunities.
Through our events, such as the MADE IN CONGO entrepreneurship fair, we create spaces where entrepreneurs, experts and partners meet to bring high-impact projects to life.
[Add the year the company was founded, the founder's name and the company's story here.]
